profile.description: Gardiner rodeo/horse-drive organizer relationship. The Gardiner Chamber is not the event organizer; Adventure Zone was redirected to Hell's A-Roarin' / Upper Yellowstone Roundup Association.

notes.subject: Correct organizer identified - Chamber is not the rodeo contact
notes.body: The Gardiner Chamber replied Dec. 18, 2023 that it does not run the Gardiner rodeo and directed Adventure Zone to Hell's A-Roarin' Outfitters. Current Gardiner tourism information confirms the associated Hell's A-Roarin' Horse Drive remains active and identifies the Upper Yellowstone Roundup Association as organizer, phone 406-223-1222 and email gardinermtrodeo@yahoo.com. Preserve the Chamber reply as a redirect, not a decline. Before future outreach, verify which Gardiner rodeo/horse-drive event is the target and whether a family-attraction area genuinely fits.

notes.subject: Kristy call notes — stale number preserved
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten call sheet lists Upper Yellowstone Roundup in Gardiner, Montana, phone 406-848-7010, and explicitly marks that number as wrong. Preserve this as historical call evidence and do not reuse the stale number.

followUps.label: Review 2027 Gardiner rodeo/horse-drive fit
followUps.reason: The old outreach went to the wrong organization. Verify the specific 2027 event, organizer and available family-entertainment footprint before contacting the Upper Yellowstone Roundup team.
